newsitem.title: USA: Smith International Inc buys Tipsa SA unit.
newsitem.headline: Smith International Inc buys Tipsa SA unit.

text.p: Smith International Inc said Friday it had completed the acquisition of a unit of Tipsa SA which performs inspections without tearing down structures or equipment.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said in a statement the unit is based in Argentina and operates in the four major oil producing areas of the country.
The unit, which reported revenues of about $11 million in 1996, will become part of the Smith Drilling & Completions business unit.
